leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a Node.js server with Express to serve static files from a designated directory.
Configure middleware to restrict file access to specific, safe file extensions.
Implement path validation to prevent directory traversal attacks in file requests.
Apply security headers to static file responses to mitigate common web vulnerabilities.
Initialize a logging mechanism to record file access attempts and errors.
Integrate a rate-limiting rule to control excessive requests to static resources.
Manipulate the server to return custom error pages for unauthorized file access.
lessonTitle: Build secure static file serving rules
